test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following locations was 'Nataraja', a stone male dancing figure discovered?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harappa**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nataraja', a stone male dancing figure discovered at Harappa. Hence, Option 4 is correct.**
 
• 
 
 
 

 
 
**Site__**

 
 
 
**__Excavator__**

 
 
 
**__Region__**

 
 
 
**__Findings__**

 
 
 

 
 
**Harrapan**

 
 
 
Dayaram Sahani (1921)

 
 
 
Montogomery district of Pakistan, Left bank of river Ravi.

 
 
 
 
• Rows of 6 granaries.
 
• Stone lingam & yoni figures.
 
• Wheat & Barley in the wooden altar.
 
• **Dancing Nataraja.**
 
• Copper scale, mirror, vanity box, dice.
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Mohenjodaro**

 
 
 
RD Banerjee (1922)

 
 
 
Larkana district in Sindh on the right bank of Indus.

 
 
 
 
• Pashupati seals.
 
• Bronze sculpture of a dancing girl.
 
• Steatite image of a breaded man.
 
• Terracotta figurine of Mother Goddess.
 
• Three cylindrical seals.
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Surkotada**

 
 
 
Shri Jagat Pati (1964-68)

 
 
 
Situated in the Shadi Kaur river in Gujarat’s Kutch district.

 
 
 
Evidence of horse.

 
 
 

 
 
**Amri**

 
 
 
MG Majumdar (1929)

 
 
 
Situated in Sindh, on the bank of the river Indus.

 
 
 
Evidence of antelope.

 
 
 

 
 
**Chanhudaro**

 
 
 
MG Majumdar (1931)

 
 
 
Situated in Sindh, on the bank of the river Indus.

 
 
 
 
• A huge number of copper implements.
 
• Specialized drills for brad making.
 
• Shops of shell ornament makers.
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Kalibangan**

 
 
 
A Ghosh (1953-60)

 
 
 
Situated in Rajasthan on the left bank of the river Ghaggar.

 
 
 
 
• Seven fire altars.
 
• Cylindrical seals.
 
• Wheels of toy carts.
 
• Black bangles.
 
• Joint burials.
 
 
 
 

 
 
**Kot Diji**

 
 
 
Fazal Ahmed (1953-54)

 
 
 
Situated on the left bank of the river Indus

 
 
 
 
• Wheels made painted pottery.
 
• Artistic toys.
 
• Five figurines of Mother Goddess
